title: headcount-sync-hiring-loop-prep-scratchpad-olivia
content:
Purpose / context:
- Prep notes for weekly headcount sync with Eng and Product hiring partners (weekly triage + ask review). Running through open reqs, interview loop health, offer pipeline, and org planning asks for Q1 2026 budget cycle.

Attendees (planned):
- Priya Desai (Hiring Partner, Eng)
- Ethan Zhao (Eng Manager, Serving Runtime)
- Maya Rivera (Eng Manager, Console)
- Samir Patel (Hiring Manager, Observability) 
- Olivia Martinez (People Ops) — facilitator

Agenda (30-40m):
1) Quick numbers snapshot (3m) — open reqs, offers out, accept rate
2) Interview loop health (8m) — backlog, interviewer coverage, feedback quality
3) Prioritization / slates for next 2 wks (10m) — which roles to prioritize for sourcing / paid outreach
4) Org planning ask review (10m) — new headcount requests vs backfills, urgency + budget code
5) Action items & blockers (5m)

Quick numbers (to read aloud):
- Total open reqs across Eng/Product: 17 (9 eng IC, 4 eng managers, 4 product roles)
- Offers extended (since last sync): 3
- Offers accepted (since last sync): 1
- Offer acceptance rate YTD: ~72% (need to confirm with compensation team)
- Pipeline: ~42 active candidates across top 6 priority roles

Notes / flags to raise:
- Interviewer burnout: Ethan called out that serving-runtime team is short on seasoned interviewers (esp. infra/system-design). We should consider shifting 2 senior staff from non-critical projects to interview rotation for next 4 weeks.
- Loop slowness for Staff SWE candidates: average time from screen -> on-site currently 26 days (goal <14). Root cause: scheduling lag and sparse interviewer availability.
- Candidate ghosting: increased on backend roles — follow-up cadence needs review. Recommend templated 48hr follow-up + scheduling link.
- Compensation approvals: 2 manager-level offers pending sign-off from comp committee (HR-342). If committee delays >5 days, risk losing candidates.
- Headcount ask from Observability (Samir): +2 ICs (SWE) Q1 hire, high priority due to product commitments. Need aligned business case + budget code.
- Backfill vs net-new: Product has 1 headcount ask that might be reclassified as backfill if L5 PM transfer completes — need confirmation from product ops.

Interview loop / candidate highlights (quick bullets):
- Candidate A (SWE-III, serving runtime): strong infra experience, concerns about availability (2 weeks notice). Interview feedback: 4/5 across barraisers, flagged for deeper system design. Recommendation: move to take-home + onsite.
- Candidate B (Staff SWE candidate): mixed feedback; strong architecture but limited distributed systems ops. Consider second technical screen focused on scalability.
- Candidate C (Product Manager): excellent PM sense, borderline on domain experience (infra). PM lead open to slightly junior if strong launch track record.

Org planning asks (prep for budget cycle):
- Samir (Observability): +2 SWE ICs (reqs OBS-201, OBS-202). Business justification: roadmap item "tracing scale" — impact on latency SLOs and customer retention. Priority: high.
- Priya (Serving Runtime): +1 Senior SWE (IC) contractor -> Full-time conversion ask from existing contractor for continuity on kernel selection work. Priority: medium-high.
- Product (console team): +1 PM (net-new) — flagged until internal transfer completes. Priority: medium.
- Cross-cutting ask: fund dedicated interview time (0.2 FTE per senior IC) for 6 weeks to speed loops. Cost to be estimated.

Open questions to surface in sync:
- Can Eng leadership temporarily reallocate interview capacity? (Ethan to confirm who can step in)
- Comp committee timeline/expectation — can we escalate 2 manager approvals? (Olivia to ping compensations lead)
- Are there budget constraints from finance for Q1 hires? Any freeze risk? (Priya to check with FP&A)

Draft talking points (for Olivia):
- "We have a strong top-of-funnel, but time-in-loop is our biggest leak. A focused interviewer rotation and templated candidate follow-ups will materially reduce drop-offs."
- "For Samir's ask: please attach a 2-line impact statement and expected delivery timeline so People Ops can prioritize against Q1 budget."
- "Recommend comp committee expedite manager-level approvals for the two outstanding offers — we risk losing both if we don't get sign-off within 5 business days."

Action items (owner / due):
- Ethan: Confirm 2 senior engineers who can join interview rotation for 4 weeks. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Priya: Clarify whether product's PM ask is net-new vs backfill; send final ask + budget code. Due: 2026-03-04.
- Olivia: Escalate comp approvals HR-342 to compensation lead, call out 5-day SLA. Also update headcount tracker. Due: 2026-03-03.
- Samir: Submit 2-line business impact statement for OBS-201/202 and link to roadmap ticket. Due: 2026-03-04.
- Recruiting: (cc @recruiting) Implement templated 48hr follow-up workflow and share draft. Due: 2026-03-06.
- People Ops: Estimate cost of dedicating 0.2 FTE interview time per senior IC for 6 weeks (budget estimate). Due: 2026-03-09.

Follow-ups after the meeting (notes to self):
- Update Confluence headcount page with any approved changes and new req IDs.
- Re-run loop metric snapshot (time from screen -> onsite) after week 2 of interviewer rotation; share before next sync.
- If comp committee misses SLA, prepare fallback: escalate to Head of Eng for sign-off contingency.

Misc scratch / prompts to remember (notes to self):
- Bring up potential short-term contract extensions for critical contributors to avoid gaps (esp. kernel/quantization work).
- Check previous retro notes on candidate outreach cadence (Confluence link in artifacts).
- Add sample calendar blocks to invite (30m) and include recruiting and compensation leads as optional.

Raw meeting prep checklist (pre-meeting):
- [ ] Pull latest headcount tracker CSV (People Ops)
- [ ] Update pipeline counts for top 6 roles
- [ ] Confirm attendees + calendar invite
- [ ] Slack ping comp lead about HR-342

Tone: keep this brief in meeting, focus on concrete asks and timelines. If topics need deeper discussion, schedule a follow-up with hiring managers only.

---
Revision log / quick history:
- 2025-11-15: initial notes created (Olivia)
- 2026-02-20: added interviews snapshot and candidate highlights (Ethan)
- 2026-02-28: updated action items and dates after pre-sync with Priya

End of doc.
